Frank, let’s cut the act. The “Republican retreat” you’re talking about could end today if your side simply passed the clean continuing resolution sitting right in front of you — no pork, no hidden spending, no games. But instead of acting like adults, you’re holding the government hostage so you can slip in long-term budget items that have nothing to do with keeping people fed or paid.
